Clinical Trials.Name: SAPPHIRE, 2004
Clinical Trials.Key Features: Multicenter randomized trial of patients with >50% symptomatic carotid stenosis (58%) or >80% asymptomatic carotid stenosis (42%) with 1 or more comorbidity criteria (high-surgical-risk group).
Clinical Trials.Comments: Terminated prematurely because of a drop in randomization.

Clinical Trials.Name: SAPPHIRE, 2008
Clinical Trials.Key Features: Multicenter randomized trial of patients with >80% asymptomatic carotid stenosis (70%) and >50% symptomatic carotid stenosis (30%).
Clinical Trials.Comments: No significant difference could be shown in long-term outcomes between patients who underwent CAS with EPD and those who underwent CEA.

Clinical Trials.Name: CREST, 2010
Clinical Trials.Key Features: The study included 1,321 symptomatic patients and 1,181 asymptomatic patients. Symptomatic patients in the study had >50% carotid stenosis by angiography, >70% by ultrasound, or >70% by CTA or MRA. Asymptomatic patients in the study had carotid stenosis (patients with symptoms beyond 180 d were considered asymptomatic) >60% by angiography, >70% by ultrasound, or >80% by CTA or MRA.
Clinical Trials.Comments: The risk of the composite primary outcome of stroke, MI, or death did not differ significantly among symptomatic and asymptomatic patients between CAS and CEA.

Neurological Complications.Overall Stroke Incidence: 5.5% in the ARCHER trial, with disabling stroke in 1.5% and relatively minor events in 4.0% of cases.
Neurological Complications.Device Malfunction: Occurs in <1% of procedures and is associated with deployment failure, stent malformation, and migration.
